The games differ slightly in how the scoring and attacking works. Ingress used only statues, counting, art installations, public places like libraries, and murals as capturable points. Also currency was generated by walking around as you picked up scattered energy points. The strength of a point was determined by the level nodes attached to it which are obtained by accessing any capture point. Honestly I think Ingress is better designed but Pokemon Go has a big popular brand behind it which is why it became popular.
